Account snapshot: BridgeOps builds a cloud contact-center product used by ~50 mid-size customers; heavy focus on agent-assist (real-time suggestions), automated post-call ticketing, and adaptive reranking for KB retrieval. Currently on mixed stack: OpenAI for generation + in-house reranker + 3rd-party vector DB. Exploring replacement to reduce 99p latency and per-token costs during holiday spikes.

Recent timeline (bullets from AE/SE):
- 2026-02-18: 60m call (ff_2026-02-18_3092). AE E. Patel + SE M. Chen + SRE lead present. Went over Redwood Dedicated offering and multi-tier routing. SRE concerned about burst behaviour; asked for proof of graceful degradation.
- 2026-02-25: Security review kickoff; BridgeOps sent SSO/SAML configs and data flow diagram. Requested KMS & audit log retention SLA. (drive:/security/bridgeops-security-questions-2026-02.xlsx).
- 2026-03-01: Demo of agent-assist latency on small dataset. Observed median latency ~120ms, p95 ~420ms under synthetic load — BridgeOps target p95 < 400ms.
- 2026-03-04: Pricing review with finance; initial ARR estimate 80k-250k. Concern: cost under 2x current provider during spikes.
- 2026-03-05: SE ran short-run comparative POC (OpenAI vs Redwood hosted + dedicated). Early results: token cost ~35% lower on dedicated; hallucination on long-context KB retrieval ~4% — must reduce.

Use-case & requirements (copied from call notes):
- Workloads: real-time agent suggestions (latency-critical), ticket summarization (batch), API-driven tool-calls (CRM writes, ticket triage).
- Traffic profile: baseline 30 req/s across fleet; planned seasonal spikes to 200-250 req/s for sustained 20-30 minutes during promos.
- Latency targets: median <200ms for assistant suggestions, p95 <400ms. Throughput: scale to 250 req/s with autoscaling + prewarmed capacity.
- Quality: maintain or improve F1 on intent extraction and entity capture vs current system; reduce hallucination on KB lookups.
- Routing/fallback: require deterministic fallback to smaller cheaper model during capacity limits; prefer model pinning and semantic routing by customer tier.
- Security: SSO/SAML, audit logs stored for 12 months, KMS for key management, EU data residency for several customers.

Quote from product: "We need predictable latency during Black Friday-like spikes — last year OpenAI throttled us and we had escalations."

POC plan: 2-week POC on Redwood Dedicated. Scope: agent-assist canonical flows, tool-calling sandbox (no real writes), compare latency cost curves and validate KV cache effectiveness. Deliverables: perf report, cost projection, security checklist answers.

Open items / blockers: budget commit from Platform lead (due 2026-03-22), security needs a KMS design doc and evidence of audit retention. Vector DB migration path (how Redwood integrates with existing reranker) still TBD.

Suggested Redwood play: propose dedicated pool with autoscale+burst for seasonality, model quantization for cheaper tail-costs, and canary rollback routes for critical tool-calls. SE notes: prioritize reducing p95 under synthetic 2-minute sustained burst test.
